title: Lakshya Sen Exits Denmark Open First Round, Srikanth and Tanvi Progress
indian_angle: India's Lakshya Sen faced an early exit, while Kidambi Srikanth and Tanvi Sharma advanced in the Denmark Open.
summary: Lakshya Sen was defeated by Chou Tien Chen in the first round of the Denmark Open, though fellow Indians Kidambi Srikanth and Tanvi Sharma secured their spots in the next stage.

title: Sindhu Faces An Se-young, Lakshya Sen Gets Chou Test at Denmark Open
indian_angle: Indian stars PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen were set for challenging opening matches against top international opponents at the Denmark Open.
summary: PV Sindhu was drawn against formidable An Se-young, and Lakshya Sen against Chou Tien Chen, highlighting a tough start for India's top shuttlers at the Denmark Open.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee aims to give Indian badminton players a stronger voice in the sport's governance and decision-making.
summary: Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, designed to enhance player representation and involvement in the sport's organizational structure.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 Begins in Guwahati
indian_angle: This national camp in Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's young talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing the Indian contingent for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This advanced coaching course is vital for improving the quality of badminton coaching across India, directly impacting player development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India conducted a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course across two national centers, aiming to upskill coaches for better player development.
